title: Manually Trace Security-Sensitive Agent-Written Swift
summary: JC Mobile App Studio reports using Claude for much of its Swift implementation while still tracing every security- or data-handling change line by line before release. An iOS team can use multi-model review to find blind spots, but keep a codebase-aware human as the final reviewer for sensitive diffs.
takeaway: Classify security, privacy, authentication, and data-handling diffs as mandatory human-review work; use a second model as a noisy detector, never as the accountability boundary.
